name: Taylor Christianson
title: Senior Unity Game Dev / Lead Programmer
bio: A versatile game developer and technical lead who builds every part of a game: gameplay, systems architecture, AI, multiplayer netcode, tools, and tech art.

At Halfbrick Studios I rose from Graduate to Lead Programmer and led a team of four from concept to launch, and I've since built co-op multiplayer titles at Panda Paw Entertainment, owning deep gameplay and networking systems end to end.
I turn ideas into polished, playable games from prototype to production, and work fluently with modern AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code.
